_note: One headline series per Eurostat SDG dataset (EU SDG indicator set). filter = dimension values kept; sign = +1 if higher values are better, -1 otherwise; target = editorial association with a UN SDG target (pairs within the same SDG are excluded, so the target only separates nodes). Datasets without country data, breakdowns of another headline (suffix a: by citizenship or degree of urbanisation), and indicators whose desired direction is ambiguous at national level are listed under excluded.
